title: Sensitive detection of antigen-specific T-cells using bead-bound antigen for in vitro re-stimulation
author: Bronge, Kaiser, et al.

steps.title: Grow transformed E. coli
steps.instruction: Inoculate transformed E. coli into 500 ml auto‑induction medium containing kanamycin, glycerol, MgSO₄, arabinose, lactose and glucose, then incubate at 25 °C overnight.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 9,000 g and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cell pellet in denaturing buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in lysis buffer composed of 6 M Guanidinium‑HCl, 10 mM Tris‑HCl, 50 mM NaH₂PO₄, 100 mM NaCl and 20 mM β‑mercaptoethanol, pH 8.0; then freeze the suspension at –80 °C.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen lysate, then centrifuge at 23,500 g and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Purify antigens with Ni‑beads
steps.instruction: Add His Mag Sepharose Ni Beads (GE Healthcare) to the clarified lysate, allow binding, and perform washes as appropriate (details not specified).

steps.title: Elute antigens from beads
steps.instruction: Elute bound antigens using elution buffer containing 6 M urea, 0.05 % Tween 20, 10 mM β‑mercaptoethanol, 10 mM MES, pH 3.0.

steps.title: Adjust eluate pH
steps.instruction: Raise the pH of the eluate to 5.0 by adding 0.82 M MES buffer, pH 6.0.
